Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on the structural analysis of GPI anchors (glycolipids) attached to the CD59 protein. The workflow involves PI-PLC release of the anchor, affinity purification of the protein-anchor complex via GST-tag, and subsequent LC-MS/MS to identify specific glycoforms. While the PRIDE metadata lists 'acetylated residue', the main text describes the analysis of GPI glycoforms (glycosylation).

scope: HFGF-CD59 was liberated from the cell surface by phosphatidylinositol-specific phospholipase C (PI-PLC), affinity-purified and analyzed.
Supernatants were loaded on the columns filled with 0.25 mL of Glutathione Sepharose 4B (GE healthcare) at 4 °C. After washing with 5 mL PBS, HFGF-CD59 was eluted by 5 mL elution-buffer A
